description: Session ledger: export the plugin root so the docs can run scripts/ledger.sh, reap ledgers untouched for 90 days, remind the session of its open needs on each of the owner's prompts so it resolves the ones the owner answered, and keep in-process subagents from writing their parent's ledger. The module is the band above the prompt of this session's open needs, and /ledger-band.
